desk-unset.note: Light theme #b45309, dark theme #fbbf24. Operator state only.

desk-set.note: Light theme #047857, dark theme #34d399. Operator state only.

desk-killed.note: Light theme #b91c1c, dark theme #f87171. Operator state only.

desk-standing.note: Light theme #475569, dark theme #94a3b8. Operator state only.

desk-tonight.note: Light theme #be123c, dark theme #fb7185. Operator state only.

sleeve-red.note: Social-event field colour. Deep variant #a8182c is the cover-art ground; also the back-cover Side A/B label ink on every pressing.

sleeve-mustard.note: Recurring-class field colour. Deep variant #c99400 is the cover-art ground; ink on this field is midnight.

sleeve-midnight.note: Workshop field colour and the back-cover text ink. Deep variant #10102a is the cover-art ground when this is the field.

sleeve-cream.note: The back cover's paper ground and every pressing's on-field ink/frame colour, regardless of which field it backs.

categoryChips.note: Taxonomy categories (attendee type, dance style). A chip names a category and never reports state; the five desk state colours stay reserved for state. Tokens live in src/styles/admin.css as --admin-chip-<hue>-tint / -ink with dark variants.

logoFallback.purpose: Decorative brand-rose ground for logo/monogram fallback tiles on operator surfaces.

red-error.purpose: Error text on dark grounds (public forms). AA on --bg and --surface.

red-error-strong.purpose: Error headings and error-link hover on dark grounds.

red-line.purpose: Error banner borders on dark grounds.

blue-mid.purpose: Class-event indigo mid tone; gradient stop on card media.

blue-pale.purpose: Class-event indigo pale tone; secondary text on indigo grounds.

gradient-primary.purpose: DESIGN.md primary button gloss: subtle top-down shine over Rose Red.

displayBand.purpose: Poster titles, hero figures and splash headings set per surface; anchored by display-md (3rem) and display-lg (4.5rem). Not a step list.

typeRamp.artworkExemption: SVG artwork lettering (the vinyl label print, 3.6px/6.6px) answers to no ramp. The Sleeve's cover title (54-128px, stepped by character count) carries the same exemption; see typographyMeta.poster-lettering.

desk-agate.purpose: Operator listing rows. Never used for controls.

desk-entry-title.purpose: The name of a night inside a listing row.

desk-label.purpose: Measure titles, day headings, count labels, state flags.

desk-figure.purpose: The work counts in the desk's standing rule.

wordmark.purpose: The script Salsa Segura lockup. The only place Great Vibes appears; never a heading or flourish.

identifier.purpose: Tabular mono identifiers an operator reads character by character: IDs, hashes, raw payloads.

poster-lettering.purpose: Shrikhand. The Sleeve's cover title band only — never a heading, never body copy. Sized 54-128px (story, stepped by character count), ×0.8 on feed; export-pixel artwork, answers to no UI ramp.

poster-condensed.purpose: Barlow Condensed 600/800. Everything on the Sleeve besides the cover title: masthead, sticker, track list, Side B. Tabular lining numerals throughout (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums).

poster-condensed-bold.purpose: Barlow Condensed 800. Track numbers/values, masthead, Side-label headings, price and scan CTA — the Sleeve's bold weight, paired with poster-condensed's 600 for labels.

shadows.name: glow-primary
shadows.purpose: Public world only. Neon halo under active rose elements. Never reaches the Sleeve.

shadows.name: sheet-elevation
shadows.purpose: The one stated elevation for the event sheet/dialog: a real offset shadow. The rose glow that used to stack on top was a zero-offset halo and is gone.

shadows.name: admin-sm
shadows.purpose: Record-surface cards and dialogs (light theme; dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)). Desk surfaces still take none.

shadows.name: desk-none
shadows.purpose: The operator desk declares no elevation. Rules and measures divide; nothing lifts.

shadows.name: sleeve-none
shadows.purpose: The Sleeve declares no elevation at all, more strictly than the desk: it is printed matter, so nothing on it ever casts a shadow, not even the desk's border-only device.

motion.name: ease-out-enter
motion.purpose: System standard easing: entrances, state transitions, sheet motion across both worlds.

motion.name: sheet-drag
motion.purpose: Sheet snap-back after an incomplete drag. No transition mid-drag (finger-follower); reduced motion drops it to a jump cut.

motion.name: desk-settle
motion.purpose: Arrival and count-pulse easing for Set in place.

motion.name: desk-leave
motion.purpose: A decided entry leaving the galley, 420ms.

motion.name: desk-state
motion.purpose: Control border, background and colour changes.

breakpoints.name: sheet
breakpoints.note: The event modal becomes a drag-to-dismiss bottom sheet below this (max-width: 767.98px).

components.name: Desk Listing Row
components.description: One entry in the galley or the set column. The margin mark carries state; content hangs on a constant indent.
components.html:
• Rooftop Bachata Social

    9:00 PM · Havana Club

    No flyer
components.css: .ds-desk-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0,1fr); gap: 0 14px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.35 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; list-style: none; } .ds-mark { color: #b45309; padding-top: 1px; } .ds-desk-title { margin: 0; font: 700 0.9375rem/1.3 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; color: #1e293b; } .ds-desk-meta { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #64748b; } .ds-desk-meta b { font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; } .ds-desk-flags { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 600 0.6875rem/1.2 'Epilogue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b45309; }

components.name: Desk Decision Button
components.description: Approve and Reject in the galley. Full UI size regardless of the agate rows around it.
components.css: .ds-desk-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font: 700 0.75rem 'Epilogue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-desk-action--set { border-color: #047857; color: #047857; } .ds-desk-action--set:hover { background: #ecfdf5; } .ds-desk-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e11d48; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Desk Division Head
components.description: One of the week's seven divisions. Holds its place even when nothing is set.
components.css: .ds-division { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 0 4px; } .ds-division-day { font: 800 0.6875rem 'Epilogue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #be123c; } .ds-division-date { font: 400 0.6875rem 'Epilogue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #64748b; } .ds-division-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: #be123c; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The public world's commit action: solid Rose Red with a subtle top-down gloss, white label, uppercase tracked label type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.8rem 1.75rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff3d63, #e11d48); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffe088; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Operator taxonomy chip: a category label, never a state report. Light values shown; dark variants in extensions.categoryChips.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip--rose { background: #ffe4e6; color: #be123c; } .ds-chip--blue { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; }

components.name: Gold Text Link
components.description: The sheet's link role (address, contacts, series). Gold on dark; the target clears the 24px minimum and 44px on coarse pointers.
components.css: .ds-gold-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; color: #e9c349; font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-gold-link:hover { color: #ffe088; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-gold-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffe088; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-gold-link { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Event Sheet with Drag Handle
components.description: The mobile event sheet. One elevation shadow; a full-width 28px grab strip at the lip drags to dismiss (96px or flick), snaps back otherwise, and never fires on interrupted gestures.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; max-height: 96dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0; background: #131b2e; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); transform: translateY(var(--sheet-drag, 0px)); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-sheet.is-dragging { transition: none; } .ds-sheet-handle { display: flex; height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; touch-action: none; cursor: grab; } .ds-sheet-handle::before { content: ""; width: 36px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); } .ds-sheet-title { margin: 0; padding: 8px 20px 16px; font: 800 1.5rem/1.1 'Epilogue', sans-serif; color: #dae2fd; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { transition: none; } }

components.name: Sleeve Front Cover
components.description: The Sleeve's square front cover: flyer or fallback art, a lettered title band in Poster Lettering, and a circular price sticker. The same component renders full-size on the exported poster and scaled down as the night card's thumbnail.
components.html:
Salsa Sunday

Entry$15
components.css: .ds-sleeve-cover { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 1; background: #a8182c; border: 6px solid #f4ecd8; font-family: 'Poster Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-sleeve-cover__art { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; } .ds-sleeve-cover__art img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-sleeve-cover__band { padding: 14px 18px; background: #d7263d; border-top: 6px solid #f4ecd8; } .ds-sleeve-cover__title { margin: 0; color: #f4ecd8; font-family: 'Poster Lettering', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 34px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-sleeve-sticker { position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 78px; aspect-ratio: 1; color: #1b1b3a; background: #f4ecd8; border: 3px solid #1b1b3a; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-9deg); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sleeve-sticker__label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-sleeve-sticker__price { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Sleeve Track Row
components.description: One line of the back-cover Side A track list: a numbered track, a Poster Condensed label, a dotted leader, and a bold tabular value — the poster's own vocabulary for event facts (date, time, venue, styles).
components.css: .ds-sleeve-track { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px auto 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 0 8px; padding: 10px 0; background: #f4ecd8; color: #1b1b3a; font-family: 'Poster Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sleeve-track__no { color: #d7263d; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; } .ds-sleeve-track__label { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-sleeve-track__leader { align-self: end; min-width: 16px; margin-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 3px dotted currentColor; opacity: 0.55; } .ds-sleeve-track__value { font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; text-align: right; }

narrative.northStar: Three worlds: Ritmo Vivo for the dance floor, The Listings Desk for the back of house, and The Sleeve for the one artifact that leaves the site
narrative.overview: Salsa Segura is a listings publication with a public face, a working desk, and a printed artifact that travels. Ritmo Vivo is the face: high-contrast, glassmorphic, built to feel like a night out. The Listings Desk is the desk: agate listings type, copy-desk proof marking, rules instead of cards, read for hours in a lit room. The Sleeve is the poster: every night pressed as a 1970s Fania-era salsa LP sleeve, spot-colour fields and Shrikhand lettering, judged against other posters in a friend's story or group chat rather than against the site around it. Each world exists because its job is opposite the others', and dressing one as another fails all three.
keyCharacteristics: Public world is dark, glassmorphic and expressive; operator world is light-or-dark, ruled and dense; the poster is flat 1970s LP-sleeve print
Five operator state colours are law and never decorate
The operator desk and the Sleeve both declare no elevation at all
Decisions propagate once, in place, without routing
UI type sits on a nine-step rem ramp; both display composition and the Sleeve's cover title are documented bands, not ramp steps

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: The five desk state colours are used for state and nothing else, so an operator reads a column of marks without reading a label.

rules.name: Category chips are not state
rules.body: Taxonomy categories are labelled by the --admin-chip-* palette. A chip names a category and never reports an entry's state; the five state colours stay reserved for state.

rules.name: The Agate-Rows-Only Rule
rules.body: Listing scale governs rows. Every control stays at full UI size (34px minimum); the state palette carries the reading load.

rules.name: The One-Device Rule
rules.body: Border or shadow, never both. The desk chose the border and declares no elevation.

rules.name: The Sleeve Boundary Rule
rules.body: The Sleeve never appears as site UI — only as the poster export itself and its thumbnail/preview inside the event modal. Ritmo Vivo's glassmorphism and glow never enter the poster, and the Sleeve's flat spot-colour fields never leak back into Ritmo Vivo.

rules.name: The Pressing-Codes-Type Rule
rules.body: The field colour is the only signal of event type on the poster; it is never reused for anything else on the sleeve, and Side A/Side B labels print red on every pressing regardless of which field it backs.

rules.name: The Artwork-Not-Ramp Rule
rules.body: The Sleeve's cover title size (54-128px story, ×0.8 feed, stepped by character count) is artwork sized for the printed sleeve and answers to no UI type ramp — the same exemption the vinyl label print already has.

dos: Do keep the three worlds separate: Ritmo Vivo for dancers, The Listings Desk for operators, The Sleeve for the one artifact that leaves the site.
Do state only counts that represent work in the desk's standing rule.
Do hold the five state colours to state alone, in both light and dark admin themes.
Do keep operator controls at 34px or larger even beside agate rows.
Do let a decision propagate once, across galley, column and counts together.
Do press event type to field colour alone (red social, mustard class, midnight workshop) and print Side A/Side B labels red on every pressing.
Do set the Sleeve in Poster Lettering (titles) and Poster Condensed (everything else), never Epilogue or Be Vietnam Pro.
donts: Don't put a KPI stat-card grid on an operator surface; inventory figures belong to the analytics page.
Don't add cards, panels or shadows to the desk.
Don't use glyphs or emoji as marks or icons; marks are drawn geometry and icons come from Lucide.
Don't shrink a control to match agate type, or grow agate type to match a control.
Don't route an operator to a separate page for a decision the galley can carry in place.
Don't let Ritmo Vivo's glassmorphism, glow or gradients reach the Sleeve, and don't let the Sleeve's flat fields leak back into Ritmo Vivo.
Don't show the Sleeve anywhere but the poster export and its thumbnail/preview inside the event modal.
Don't add a shadow anywhere on the poster; the Sleeve prints flat.
